description.narrative: Long Term Technical Assistance and Stewardship Function for the EPD Programme. The human development department’s (HDD) mission is to promote universal health coverage (UHC) and ensure women and girls thrive and survive by supporting comprehensive sexual and reproductive health and rights, strengthening health, WASH and food systems and improving nutrition, with a focus on those left most behind. One of the department’s key aims are to end the preventable deaths of mothers, babies and children, as laid out in the International Development Strategy (IDS).
